name: Structured Intake Normalization
what_it_does: Converts forms, briefs, tickets, and unstructured requests into a validated schema; flags missing mandatory data.
common_roles: Intake, procurement, support, casework, release packaging.
minimum_fixture: Incomplete/ambiguous intake with expected missing-field and escalation outputs.

name: Task Decomposition & Dependency Mapping
what_it_does: Breaks approved work into bounded tasks, dependencies, owners, gates, and deadlines.
minimum_fixture: Multi-step request with a deliberate dependency conflict.

name: Status & Handoff Validation
what_it_does: Validates lifecycle state, output completeness, provenance, next owner, and blockers before handoff.
minimum_fixture: Handoff with missing owner/provenance and expected block.

name: Approval Routing
what_it_does: Selects the correct named approver from an approved authority matrix; never fabricates authority.
minimum_fixture: Expired and delegated approver records.

name: Policy-to-Control Mapping
what_it_does: Extracts operational controls, prohibitions, exceptions, and review triggers from approved policy texts.
minimum_fixture: Policy with ambiguous exception requiring escalation.

name: Claim Extraction & Source Citation
what_it_does: Extracts material factual claims and attaches traceable sources, dates, context, and uncertainty.
minimum_fixture: Mixed-quality source bundle containing unsupported claims.

name: Source Quality Assessment
what_it_does: Assesses authority, primary/secondary status, recency, relevance, conflict, and provenance of evidence.
minimum_fixture: Contradictory sources with stale/non-authoritative records.

name: Knowledge Retrieval & Grounded Synthesis
what_it_does: Retrieves approved information and synthesizes it without inventing unsupported facts; exposes source gaps.
minimum_fixture: Query with no authoritative answer and expected abstention/escalation.

name: Taxonomy & Metadata Tagging
what_it_does: Applies controlled vocabularies, entity IDs, relationships, classification labels, and data-quality flags.
minimum_fixture: Assets with duplicate names, uncertain types, and missing owners.

name: Version, Lineage & Provenance Tracking
what_it_does: Records source assets, transformations, prompts/workflows, contributors, tools, rights, and derivatives.
common_roles: Creative, MLOps, scientific, data, audit roles.
minimum_fixture: Derived artifact with a missing parent/source and expected block.

name: Sensitive Data Detection & Redaction
what_it_does: Identifies probable personal, confidential, or restricted data and produces minimized/redacted derivative views.
minimum_fixture: Mixed PII/PHI/confidential sample with permitted-role context.

name: Risk Classification & Escalation
what_it_does: Assigns risk tier based on defined policy signals and routes high/restricted situations to accountable humans.
minimum_fixture: Safety, financial, legal, privacy, and reputation trigger set.

name: Requirements & Acceptance-Criteria Authoring
what_it_does: Converts approved outcomes into testable, observable requirements, constraints, and acceptance conditions.
minimum_fixture: Vague requirement that must become measurable criteria.

name: Process Mapping & SOP Authoring
what_it_does: Maps inputs, decisions, controls, roles, steps, exceptions, and measurable outcomes.
minimum_fixture: Process with undefined owner and recovery path.

name: Option & Trade-off Analysis
what_it_does: Compares alternatives against explicit criteria, uncertainty, cost, risk, reversibility, and constraints.
minimum_fixture: Two plausible options with noncomparable benefits and risks.

name: Qualitative Research Coding
what_it_does: Organizes interviews, open-text feedback, and observation notes into auditable themes, quotes, contradictions, and evidence strength.
minimum_fixture: Small sample with conflicting participant statements.

name: Quantitative Analysis & Visualization
what_it_does: Produces reproducible summaries, visualizations, segmentation, anomalies, and interpretation with stated limits.
minimum_fixture: Dataset with nulls/outliers and metric-definition ambiguity.

name: Forecasting & Scenario Modeling
what_it_does: Creates transparent base/upside/downside forecasts with explicit assumptions, sensitivity, and backtesting where applicable.
minimum_fixture: Sparse/noisy time series with a structural-break condition.

name: Experiment Design & Interpretation
what_it_does: Defines hypothesis, sample, assignments, metrics, guardrails, stopping rules, and cautious readouts.
minimum_fixture: Experiment with contaminated assignment or inadequate sample.

name: Natural-Language Drafting & Adaptation
what_it_does: Drafts audience-appropriate content, documents, messages, and summaries from approved sources and tone constraints.
minimum_fixture: Source packet containing one prohibited/unverified claim.

name: Tone, Brand & Canon Conformance
what_it_does: Compares a draft to approved voice, personality, visual/sonic standards, and anti-examples; identifies drift.
minimum_fixture: Draft containing subtle tone drift and false intimacy.

name: Originality & Similarity Risk Review
what_it_does: Finds suspicious semantic, phrasing, visual, or sonic similarity and imitation cues; provides evidence, not legal conclusions.
minimum_fixture: Candidate deliberately close to a supplied reference.

name: Accessibility & Plain-Language Review
what_it_does: Checks readability, captions, contrast/design guidance, keyboard/flow considerations, alt-text, and inclusive language.
minimum_fixture: Dense document and inaccessible media example.

name: Design & Visual Continuity Review
what_it_does: Evaluates visual assets against approved references, layout systems, character rules, artifacts, safe areas, and format requirements.
minimum_fixture: Reference pack plus candidate with continuity/artifact defects.

name: Audio Continuity & Technical QA
what_it_does: Tests speech/music continuity, pronunciation, artifacts, loudness, metadata, and technical readiness.
minimum_fixture: Multiple audio candidates with voice/clip/label issues.

name: Code Generation & Secure Implementation
what_it_does: Creates maintainable code and tests within a bounded approved specification, including safe dependency and secret handling.
minimum_fixture: Feature specification with malicious/user-supplied input tests.

name: Code Review & Static-Analysis Interpretation
what_it_does: Identifies correctness, maintainability, test, security, dependency, and policy risks in change sets.
minimum_fixture: Diff with tests passing but an authorization flaw.

name: Test Design & Defect Reproduction
what_it_does: Creates positive, negative, boundary, regression, integration, and recovery tests; records reproducible evidence.
minimum_fixture: Defect report missing environment/version information.

name: Incident Triage & Runbook Retrieval
what_it_does: Correlates approved telemetry, assesses scope/severity by policy, retrieves runbooks, and routes escalation.
minimum_fixture: Alert storm with one safety/security escalation indicator.

name: Threat Modeling & Security Finding Triage
what_it_does: Identifies attack surfaces, threat scenarios, compensating controls, evidence, and remediation priority.
minimum_fixture: Design with incomplete trust-boundary information.

name: Data Quality Profiling & Drift Detection
what_it_does: Measures completeness, validity, freshness, duplicate rates, distributions, and schema drift without silently editing data.
minimum_fixture: Dataset with schema change and quality regression.

name: Model Evaluation & Red-Teaming
what_it_does: Tests AI systems for task quality, grounding, leakage, unsafe behavior, bias risk, regressions, and refusal behavior.
minimum_fixture: Representative benchmark including prompt injection and unsafe requests.

name: Contract & Obligation Extraction
what_it_does: Structures clauses, dates, parties, obligations, limitations, and comparison flags without interpreting law.
minimum_fixture: Contract with conflicting amendments and undefined terms.

name: Reconciliation & Variance Analysis
what_it_does: Matches approved records, detects discrepancies, prioritizes exceptions, and prepares support evidence.
minimum_fixture: Reconciling sources with timing differences and an unmatched record.

name: Risk Register & Control Monitoring
what_it_does: Maintains risk statements, owners, indicators, mitigations, evidence, and due dates; flags overdue/residual risk.
minimum_fixture: Risk register with missing owner and expired treatment date.

name: Customer/Case Triage & Response Drafting
what_it_does: Classifies requests, retrieves approved guidance, drafts noncommittal responses, and detects urgent/sensitive escalation.
minimum_fixture: User asks for a restricted action or legal/medical/financial advice.

name: Campaign & Content Planning
what_it_does: Maps approved campaign objectives to audiences, content pillars, assets, sequencing, test hypotheses, and measurement.
minimum_fixture: Campaign brief with insufficient assets and conflicting audience goals.

name: Community Safety & Reputation Escalation
what_it_does: Detects abuse, threats, self-harm indicators, harassment, vulnerable audiences, and reputation-sensitive conversations.
minimum_fixture: Conversation requiring immediate human response and non-engagement.

name: Rights, License & Usage-Restriction Mapping
what_it_does: Maps source/provider terms, permissions, expiry, territories, restrictions, and derivative eligibility.
minimum_fixture: Asset with unclear model terms and conflicting license evidence.

name: Release/Delivery Package Validation
what_it_does: Verifies final assets, metadata, format, checksums, approvals, evidence, and delivery status against a declared checklist.
minimum_fixture: Package with correct files but a missing approval and mismatch label.

name: Scheduling, Capacity & Route Optimization
what_it_does: Produces capacity-aware schedule options and collision/constraint warnings from authorized data.
common_roles: Operations planning, field service, release calendar.
minimum_fixture: Schedule with unavailable resource, SLA conflict, and travel constraint.

name: Quality Incident & CAPA Support
what_it_does: Organizes nonconformance evidence, root-cause hypotheses, containment drafts, corrective actions, and verification criteria.
minimum_fixture: Quality event requiring human causal assessment and release authority.

name: Localization & Cultural Adaptation
what_it_does: Adapts content for language/region while preserving meaning, voice, rights, and local requirements; flags unverifiable claims.
minimum_fixture: Content with cultural idiom, regulatory claim, and layout constraints.

name: Meeting, Decision & Action Capture
what_it_does: Converts conversations into clearly attributed decisions, action items, owners, deadlines, open questions, and risks.
minimum_fixture: Meeting containing ambiguous decision and conflicting owner assignments.

name: Evaluation Scorecard & Gate Execution
what_it_does: Applies rubric-based quality, policy, technical, and completeness checks to produce reproducible pass/fail evidence.
minimum_fixture: Artifact that passes quality but fails provenance/approval evidence.
